descriptionChirho: To be pure or clean in a moral or ritual sense — Qal intransitive stative describing the condition of being pure or blameless (Job 15:14; 25:4; Ps 51:4; Mic 6:11)
To make pure or keep clean — Piel causative-factitive, denoting the active effort to purify or maintain purity (Ps 73:13; 119:9; Prov 20:9)
To purify or cleanse oneself — Hitpael reflexive, a command to make oneself clean through self-directed moral or ritual purification (Isa 1:16)
